title: Long-Con “Investment” Scams (Pig Butchering)
summary: In these schemes a stranger builds a friendship or romance over weeks, then gradually introduces a “can't-miss” crypto opportunity on a platform they recommend.
blocks: In these schemes a stranger builds a friendship or romance over weeks, then gradually introduces a “can't-miss” crypto opportunity on a platform they recommend.
The platform is fake. Early small withdrawals may succeed to build trust, but once a large deposit is in, withdrawals stall behind endless “fees” and “taxes”.
The warning signs: an online-only relationship that steers toward money, a platform only they told you about, and pressure to deposit more to unlock what you have already put in.
